title: Looking for Something

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: If you're looking for Wireless Connection, the club is over there. Otherwise I'd suggest Brunelle's down the street.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you're looking for Wireless Connection, the club is over there. Otherwise I'd suggest Brunelle's down the street.

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: An asynchronous bar and dance club. A moment in time. Poof. And then it's gone.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: An asynchronous bar and dance club. A moment in time. Poof. And then it's gone.

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: Yeah, well, Post-Apocalypse has gone bad, and the supply of LV426 is non-existent. So don't bother.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, well, Post-Apocalypse has gone bad, and the supply of LV426 is non-existent. So don't bother.

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: Post-Ap? Seriously? It's an eye drop hallucinogen, you know? Makes you see the end of the world and feel like you survived Armageddon. Each trip is different. Fire. Floods. Nukes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Post-Ap? Seriously? It's an eye drop hallucinogen, you know? Makes you see the end of the world and feel like you survived Armageddon. Each trip is different. Fire. Floods. Nukes.

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: That feeling of survival is more than worth it. Seeing it all go down and making it through? That's the end. That's all that matters right there: surviving.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That feeling of survival is more than worth it. Seeing it all go down and making it through? That's the end. That's all that matters right there: surviving.

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: Never used to be. But lately?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Never used to be. But lately?

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: If only it were that simple.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If only it were that simple.

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: The batch is bad. So was the last one. Someone's fucking with it, adding something that makes it so intense, so euphoric to survive the end, nothing else compares. Nothing. And when you can't have that feeling all the time?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The batch is bad. So was the last one. Someone's fucking with it, adding something that makes it so intense, so euphoric to survive the end, nothing else compares. Nothing. And when you can't have that feeling all the time?

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: I'm sorry but just who the fuck are you? How did you know Tehani?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sorry but just who the fuck are you? How did you know Tehani?

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: You still didn't tell me who you are or why you're here talking to me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You still didn't tell me who you are or why you're here talking to me.

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: Magz? I swear that kid. He used to hang around Tehani. Her death shook him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Magz? I swear that kid. He used to hang around Tehani. Her death shook him.

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: When we were kids Tehani would always try to trail along. One time--get this--she got busted for a false retinal scan at this club downtown. I didn't see it happen, was already inside.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: When we were kids Tehani would always try to trail along. One time--get this--she got busted for a false retinal scan at this club downtown. I didn't see it happen, was already inside.

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: Cuz when I ordered my next drink she was the one who brought it to me! They made her work the whole night for trying to get in underage.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Cuz when I ordered my next drink she was the one who brought it to me! They made her work the whole night for trying to get in underage.

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: Yup. That's for sure. Maybe you should try to score some Post-Ap. Be a lamb and let us know if the batch is still bad.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yup. That's for sure. Maybe you should try to score some Post-Ap. Be a lamb and let us know if the batch is still bad.

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: In the end, you're just another marker and a name in the Holocropolis. Anything else you want or can I get back to work?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: In the end, you're just another marker and a name in the Holocropolis. Anything else you want or can I get back to work?

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: Have dozens more. Would be writing new ones if she had stayed away from this batch. Had just taken a break and decided enough was enough for now. At least the Holocropolis is nice.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Have dozens more. Would be writing new ones if she had stayed away from this batch. Had just taken a break and decided enough was enough for now. At least the Holocropolis is nice.

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: I don't. Normally she gets them from Idlehands. She'd been dating him for years and I don't really wanna believe it was him. They were good together.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't. Normally she gets them from Idlehands. She'd been dating him for years and I don't really wanna believe it was him. They were good together.

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: I did. Said he didn't know but was looking into it... under the radar like.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I did. Said he didn't know but was looking into it... under the radar like.

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: You're telling me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're telling me.

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: Mountains last I knew. Trying to approach a new lab or something. I don't know. I searched his place, I'll admit it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mountains last I knew. Trying to approach a new lab or something. I don't know. I searched his place, I'll admit it.

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: She'd only get her stuff from him. Trusted source and all. Wanna make yourself useful? Buy some off of him and let's see.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She'd only get her stuff from him. Trusted source and all. Wanna make yourself useful? Buy some off of him and let's see.

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: Other than a few holocordings I could have gone my entire life without seeing? Nothing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Other than a few holocordings I could have gone my entire life without seeing? Nothing.

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: Huh, maybe you don't suck.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Huh, maybe you don't suck.

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: Huh, figured you sucked. Least I was right about that. Don't worry about my dead sister by the way. I'm sure her ghost can figure it out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Huh, figured you sucked. Least I was right about that. Don't worry about my dead sister by the way. I'm sure her ghost can figure it out.

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: Good, because otherwise the Post-Apocalypse has gone bad, and the supply of LV426 is non-existent. So don't bother.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good, because otherwise the Post-Apocalypse has gone bad, and the supply of LV426 is non-existent. So don't bother.

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: I'm sure you can infer.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sure you can infer.

nodes.speaker: Sky Altra
nodes.text: You're a CorpSec agent?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're a CorpSec agent?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's Wireless Connection?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's Wireless Connection?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not looking for a drink.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not looking for a drink.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm not looking for a drink.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm not looking for a drink.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's Post-Apocalypse?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's Post-Apocalypse?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I could use a drink.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I could use a drink.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's Brunelle's?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's Brunelle's?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds fun.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds fun.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Who would be stupid enough to do that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who would be stupid enough to do that?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Who would be stupid enough to do that?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Who would be stupid enough to do that?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is it dangerous?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is it dangerous?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What happened to it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What happened to it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why you shouldn't do drugs.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why you shouldn't do drugs.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It makes you...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It makes you...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm sorry about your sister.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sorry about your sister.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I met Magz. He asked me to check on you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I met Magz. He asked me to check on you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I met Magz. He asked me to check on you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I met Magz. He asked me to check on you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Relax. It's not top secret.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Relax. It's not top secret.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Magz asked me to check on you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Magz asked me to check on you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Magz asked me to check on you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Magz asked me to check on you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Looks like it shook you too.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Looks like it shook you too.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Looks like it shook you too.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Looks like it shook you too.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: People die. It sucks but you move on.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: People die. It sucks but you move on.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: People die. It sucks but you move on.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: People die. It sucks but you move on.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How'd you find out?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How'd you find out?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you know who's poisoning it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you know who's poisoning it?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Do you know who's poisoning it?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Do you know who's poisoning it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Lovely.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Lovely.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Great story.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Great story.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Did you ask him?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Did you ask him?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Where is he?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Where is he?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Makes sense.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Makes sense.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Seems sketchy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Seems sketchy.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What'd you find?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What'd you find?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Any other leads?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Any other leads?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why not?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Absolutely not.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Absolutely not.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah, alright, fine. I'll do it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, alright, fine. I'll do it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yeah, alright, fine. I'll do it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yeah, alright, fine. I'll do it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Har. Har. Har.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Har. Har. Har.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Whatever. What I'm really here for ...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Whatever. What I'm really here for ...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Whatever. What I'm really here for ...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Whatever. What I'm really here for ...
